lines: Every verdict in this film is Sentry's own, from one run on Kubernetes: 5 sessions, 105 exchanges judged, 3 flagged.
Sentry watches every app in the cluster, and its risk dashboard shows the whole picture. Here is the pharmacy, beside a travel booking app, under the same policy.
Of 193 exchanges, 3 are critical. 12 are high and 10 medium: card and financial data moving inside the travel app. Worth reviewing, not an emergency.
These are the rules behind those numbers.
At the top: the sessions that sent Rosa's number to the forecaster, the three we just followed.
